items.english: A crop, often a legume, grown to be cut or dug back into the soil to feed it, rather than to be harvested.
items.draft: Isityalo, rhoqo esingesosapho lweembotyi (i-legume), esityalelwa ukuba sinqunyulwe ...
items.backtranslation: A plant, usually NOT of the bean family (legume), planted to be cut or dug in ...
items.problem: Negation reversed: 'often a legume' became 'usually not a legume' (-ngesosapho = not of the family).
items.corrected: Isityalo, rhoqo esesosapho lweembotyi (i-legume), esityalelwa ukuba sinqunyulwe ...
